items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I was even doing a Gracie Fields song which I did at the club later... and it was a Gracie Fields number.

ctx.x: Can you remember what some of those titles were?

Oh, I did "Little Bird Told Me," "Let Him Go, Let Him Tarry." And I was even doing a Gracie Fields song which I did at the club later, and it just didn't turn over very big. I mixed up the repertoire -- you got to put in something funny.

"I Never Cried So Much In All My Life" -- and it was a Gracie Fields number. And another one, Move It Over. Of course, that came later because that's a song that was sort of popular during the war. It had to do with what goes on in the army.
